name: Classic Plastics Corporation
old_description: Classic Plastics Corp is a custom plastics manufacturer with more than 30-years of proven expertise in polymer engineering, custom fabrication, printing & fulfillment. As the vertically integrated partner behind Heavy Duty Body Bag, our end‑to‑end capabilities allow us to deliver this high‑quality, spec‑driven product for industries that demand compliance, reliability & consistency.
about:
Classic Plastics Corporation operates from Shorewood, Illinois. The company has more than 30 years of experience in polymer engineering and custom plastics fabrication, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company specializes in custom plastics manufacturing, with a focus on body bags and mortuary supplies for death care, healthcare, and public safety sectors. Its capabilities include custom fabrication and tooling, advanced material processing, in-house printing, fulfillment, and private label services. Materials worked include vinyl, polypropylene, polyethylene, and bioplastics derived from corn and tapioca starches. Custom orders typically require a minimum of 1,000 pieces, while stock items ship within one to two business days. Facility size and employee count are not disclosed.

Classic Plastics serves the death care, healthcare, medical and scientific, government and public safety, and veterinary industries. Its B2B clients include coroners, medical examiners, police and fire departments, the U.S. Army, hospitals, morgues, anatomy labs, organ and tissue donor networks, funeral homes, funeral supply distributors, veterinary hospitals, and wildlife and farm management facilities.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated model, combining custom fabrication, printing, and fulfillment under one roof to deliver spec-driven products for compliance-heavy industries. It also highlights its pioneering work in custom bioplastics, offering chlorine-free, "Burn Wise" compliant options for cremation and alkaline hydrolysis.
